messages:
Alice K: Postmortem posted for the metering delay — we undercounted tokens for a subset of customers between 2026-03-12 and 2026-03-14. Need clear remediation owners and a timeline for invoice corrections. TL;DR: https://redwood.internal/pm/MP-2026-metering-delay
Mateo R: Thanks — reading now. Any estimate on how many customers and which tiers?
Sam (finance): Early estimate ~120 affected accounts; mostly pay-as-you-go and a few small reserved customers. Working on exact totals, will push a ledger export by EOD.
Jin L: I can own the ingestion-side fix + backfill orchestration. Plan: patch the ingestion window, re-run batch ingest, then validate token counts.
Priya S: I will take invoice correction ownership. Steps: 1) produce corrected invoices 2) apply credits where needed 3) notify customers with explanation + FAQ. Need the validated final token deltas from Jin before we start.
Alice K: Great. Can we get concrete dates? Jin, can you estimate how long the backfill + validation will take?
Jin L: Rough timeline: patch by tomorrow morning (2026-03-23), dry-run backfill on staging in 24h, full backfill + validation in 48h after dry-run. So validated deltas by 2026-03-26 EOD. Risks: long-tail edge cases in KV cache might extend validation.
Sam (finance): Once Jin confirms deltas, Priya — how long to prepare and send corrected invoices? We also need accounting sign-off for credits.
Priya S: If we get final deltas by 3/26, I can prepare credits & revised invoices by 3/29. Request: Jin, include a CSV with columns: account_id, orig_tokens, new_tokens, token_delta, suggested_credit_amount.
Jin L: Will produce that CSV. Query used for validation (staging):
```
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) as new_tokens
FROM metering_events
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-12' AND '2026-03-14'
GROUP BY account_id;
```
Will attach the CSV to the ticket.
billing-bot: Automated summary: JIRA-4567 created: "Metering undercount 2026-03-12..14". Labels: billing, postmortem, backfill. Severity: P2.
Alice K: Action items roundup (assignments + owners):
- Ingestion patch + backfill + CSV of deltas -> Jin L -> due 2026-03-26 EOD
- Invoice corrections + credits + customer comms -> Priya S -> due 2026-03-29 EOD
- Accounting verification of credits -> Sam (finance) -> provide sign-off by 2026-03-30
- Add recurring alert for delayed ingest windows -> Mateo R -> PR to monitoring by 2026-03-25
- Update runbook for this failure mode (include SQL above + validation steps) -> Jin L & Priya S -> 2026-03-31
Mateo R: I'll open the monitoring PR today, link to the alert rule + runbook sections. Also proposing a weekly sweep for ingestion lag signals for the next 4 weeks.
Sam (finance): I'll coordinate with accounting and legal on the wording for customer emails; Priya ping me when CSV is ready.
Priya S: Scheduling a short customer comms review on 3/27 10:30am PT — invite incoming.
Alice K: Let's reconvene in the postmortem channel on 2026-03-27 11am PT for status check. If any blocker appears, ping me + escalate to oncall. :thumbsup:
Mateo R: noted, will add a tracking row in the remediation spreadsheet and flag dependencies.
Jin L: uploading CSV to JIRA-4567 now + will attach validation logs.
Sam (finance): thanks everyone. I'll start drafting the accounting memo and the customer FAQ template.
Priya S: thanks, team.
